data.rationale: HDFC Bank post-merger is expected to maintain strong loan growth of 12-14% driven by retail and MSME segments, normalizing from merger base effects. NIM to stabilize at 3.8-3.9% as merged entity optimizes liability mix and benefits from improving CASA ratio (44-47% trajectory). Credit costs remain benign at 0.8-0.9% reflecting best-in-class underwriting. Operating leverage from merger synergies drives cost-to-income improvement to sub-40% by FY30E. Strong profitability metrics with ROA expanding to 2.1% and ROE reaching 18% as integration completes and cross-selling opportunities materialize. Capital adequacy remains comfortable above regulatory requirements supporting growth and dividends.
